visual_options.title: Checked Samples by Expected Drug
visual_options.subtitle: Submitted samples sized by the drug they were expected to be, grouped by category. Filter by province, site, and when the sample was checked.

visual_options.title: How do samples compare to what people expect?
visual_options.subtitle: By expected drug, the percentage of samples that: (1) only contained the expected substance (no other noteworthy substances), (2) contained the expected substance plus other noteworthy substances, or (3) did not contain the expected substance.

segments.label: Only expected substance (no other noteworthy substances)

visual_options.note: Noteworthy substances include benzodiazepines, xylazine, medetomidine, nitazenes, and other substances of public health concern. Samples with no usable test results are excluded.

visual_options.title: Substances found in samples expected to be replace_expected
visual_options.subtitle: Of samples people expected to be replace_expected, how often was each substance actually found? Each line is one substance, tracked replace_period. The bold grey line shows how many samples contained anything from the selected group. A single sample often contains several substances, so lines can add up to more than 100%. Substances were identified by FTIR unless a test strip is noted.
visual_options.note: Test strips for fentanyl, benzodiazepines, nitazenes, xylazine and medetomidine are not run on every sample. Periods with fewer than 5 samples are drawn with hollow markers. The most recent period may be incomplete.
